payload_sha256.description: Digest of the observed *payload* bytes for the surface's canonical evidence object (if parsing succeeded).

url_hint.description: Optional non-normative hint for where the surface was fetched (avoid depending on it for security decisions).

previous_beacon_payload_sha256.description: Optional digest of the previous LivenessBeacon *payload* bytes (rollback/rewrites detection).

probe_cohort_plan_payload_sha256.description: Optional digest of a ProbeCohortPlan *payload* describing the watcher cohort diversity constraints (docs/127). This makes cohort-shaping attacks against the monitoring ecosystem easier to detect.

sequence.description: Optional monotonically increasing counter for watcher convenience. Not authoritative without the hash chain.

vantage.description: Optional coarse vantage metadata. Avoid IP addresses; prefer ASN/country-level fields to reduce privacy risk while still supporting cohort-shaping analysis.

asn.description: Origin ASN of the watcher vantage (best effort).

country.description: ISO country code (best effort; 2 or 3 letters).

network_type.description: Optional network class. Keep coarse to reduce fingerprinting.

notes.description: Optional short notes about the watcher vantage (avoid narratives).

region.description: Optional coarse region label used by the watcher program.

resolver_asn.description: Optional ASN of the DNS resolver used for the observation (best effort).

watchers.description: Identifiers for the watcher/monitor(s) that produced this beacon (human-readable; may map to keys out-of-band).
